title: Coefficient four with error constants 14 and 13 at explicit lengths

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total language defined by the evaluator in proof.md. At actual length N<2^20 output zero. Otherwise choose b as the least positive integer with b^5>=N^3 and ell as the first prime strictly larger than b. Put r=floor(N/ell)-1 and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Read the first ell bits as the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-ell binary polynomial P. Output zero unless X^(2^ell)=X modulo P and gcd(P,X^2-X)=1. For a valid prefix, read the next r*ell bits as x_1,...,x_r in F_2[X]/(P), in the polynomial basis with constant coefficient first. Set y_i=x_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1) and output the absolute trace of the order-t elementary symmetric polynomial in y_1,...,y_r. Ignore the final N-(r+1)*ell bits. Every prefix and ignored bit counts in N. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier define all lengths.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total language in P, hence in NP with witness bound zero, every exact circuit in the full pinned B2 model at actual length N has at least 4*N-14*N^(4/5) gates for every integer N>=2^20, and at least 4*N-13*N^(4/5) gates for every integer N>=2^25. Consequently liminf over all integer lengths N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4. The same evaluator and verifier apply throughout both bounds and all asymptotic quantifiers.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
